question: Which enrollments have no exit date? Show the client id and program code.
reply:
```sql
SELECT "people"."enrollment"."client_id", "people"."enrollment"."program_code"
FROM "people"."enrollment"
WHERE "people"."enrollment"."exited_on" IS NULL;
```
